The 2019 year was impacted by the higher than expected losses on prior years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3000 reported gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 of GBP 1,231.828m. During 2019 overall gross claims outstanding reduced (movement in provision -GBP 107.833m), but the underwriting performance was materially affected by adverse development on prior years (notably 2018 and earlier) driven largely by natural catastrophe and large loss activity. The report explicitly cites prior-year adverse development and higher-than-expected prior year losses; specific prior-year natural catastrophe impacts were reported for 2016, 2017 and 2018 (aggregated net impacts disclosed). No single explicit gross prior-year-only movement figure was published in the notes, so a gross prior-year development amount could not be unambiguously isolated from the published reconciliation.

The 2016 year was impacted by natural catastrophe losses on the Alberta wildfires and hurricane Matthew with net losses of GBP 17.9m.

The 2017 year was impacted by several natural catastrophes with net losses of GBP 74.6m; hurricane Harvey; hurricane Irma; hurricane Maria; Mexico earthquake; Northern and Southern California wildfires.
The 2018 year was impacted by natural catastrophe net losses of GBP 22.8m; California Wildfires; hurricane Florence; hurricane Michael.
Underwriting losses of GBP 149.5m over the period 2015 - 2019, generating an average combined ratio of 107.0%.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year-only reserve movement amount is stated in the notes. The technical provisions reconciliation shows total gross movement in the provision for claims during 2019 of -GBP 87.851m and the change in total gross claims outstanding between 1 Jan 2019 and 31 Dec 2019 of -GBP 107.833m, but these figures include current year movements and foreign exchange effects and therefore cannot be unambiguously taken as 'prior year development' on a gross basis. The report does provide NET prior-year related information (e.g. net catastrophe losses per year and a net movement in reinsurers' share), but per extraction rules a gross PYD figure was not found; prior_year_development_gbp_m is therefore set to null. A gross claims development triangle is present (extracted) and could be used as a secondary method to compute PYD, but the table is presented in a staggered triangular layout and would require precise column alignment to compute diagonal movements; this was not performed here to avoid mis-calculation.
